unfiled.title: Files not filed under any application
unfiled.label: Unfiled

intake.tooLargeDescription: It is filed, and jojo shows it with every web address in it blocked and its links switched off, so viewing it here reaches nothing on the network — but anything it loads from the web will be missing.
intake.addressesDescription_one: It is filed as you dropped it, and jojo shows it with that address blocked and its links switched off, so viewing it here reaches nothing on the network. Pictures or styles it loaded from the web will be missing.
intake.addressesDescription_other: It is filed as you dropped it, and jojo shows it with every one of them blocked and its links switched off, so viewing it here reaches nothing on the network. Pictures or styles it loaded from the web will be missing.
intake.foldersDescription: jojo files documents one at a time. Open the folder and drop the files in it.
intake.reattachedDescription: The row was already here without its document. It has one now.
intake.stillUnsavedDescription: This browser refused to store it again — its storage is probably still full.
intake.unsavedDescription: The row is here, but this browser refused to store the document — usually because its storage is full. Free some space and drop the same file in again; it will attach to this row rather than making a second one.
intake.alreadyHereDescription: A file of the same name is already in the vault.
intake.addedHidden: Filed under {{bucket}} — hidden while the keyword filter is on.
intake.addedHiddenVault: Filed in the Vault under {{bucket}} — hidden while the keyword filter is on.
intake.addedDescription: Filed under {{bucket}} and saved in this browser. Nothing was uploaded anywhere.
intake.addedDescriptionVault: Filed in the Vault under {{bucket}} and saved in this browser. Nothing was uploaded anywhere.
intake.skippedDescription: A file of the same name was already in the vault.

toast.noteClearedDescription: The row keeps its name, bucket and keywords.
toast.filedDescription: It shows on each of them, and the graph can find it from any.
toast.unfiledDescription: It stays in the Vault, filed under nothing.

empty.zeroDescription: Drop a posting, a paper or a draft here — or add one from your computer.

empty.bucketDescription_other: {{count}} files are filed under the other buckets.
empty.allFiledTitle: Every file is filed under an application
empty.allFiledDescription_one: All {{count}} of them. Nothing is sitting loose.
empty.allFiledDescription_other: All {{count}} of them. Nothing is sitting loose.
empty.unfiledKeywords: No unfiled file is in the selected keywords.

drop.title: Drop to add to {{bucket}}
drop.description: Name, size and type are read. Nothing is uploaded.
drop.hint: Drop files anywhere on this panel to add them to {{bucket}}.

drop.partial: Not everything in that drop was used

save.footnote: The result is filed as a new document — nothing you started from is changed. It is built here in your browser, and no part of it is uploaded.

source.noneInVault: No PDFs in the vault yet
source.dropHintEmpty: Or drop a PDF anywhere on this card. Files you save here show up in this list.
source.dropHint: Or drop a PDF anywhere on this card.

editor.title: PDF editor
editor.hint: Merge, reorganise and mark up PDFs. Everything runs in this browser — no document is uploaded.
editor.dropMerge: Drop PDFs to add them to the merge
editor.dropOpen: Drop a PDF to open it

errors.gone: {{name}} is no longer stored, so it cannot be opened.
errors.noRoom: {{name}} was filed, but its bytes would not fit in this browser's storage.

merge.savedDescription: {{pages}} from {{documents}}, filed under {{bucket}}. The originals are untouched.
merge.empty: Add two or more PDFs, or drop them onto this card. They are joined top to bottom — drag a row by its left edge to change the order — and the originals are left as they are.
merge.hint: Ranges like 1-3, 7, 9- take part of a document. Leave a box empty for all of it.

pages.empty: Choose one PDF. You can turn pages, drop them, put them in a different order, and keep only part of it.
pages.hint: Turn, move or remove a page and this becomes available.

annotate.chooseLabel: Choose a PDF to mark up
annotate.empty: Choose one PDF. Select text on the page to highlight it, or switch to Comment and click where the note belongs.
annotate.highlightHint: Select words on the page — across lines is fine — and they are marked when you let go.
annotate.commentHint: Click the page where the comment belongs.
annotate.hintEmpty: Highlight some text or add a comment first.

noPreview.page: This posting has no saved copy on this device. Captures are kept where they were taken, so one made on your phone is not here — and a row restored from a backup carries the record without the page.
noPreview.stored: Browsers render PDFs natively but not {{kind}} files. The document is stored — Save hands it to your own application.
noPreview.missing: Browsers render PDFs natively but not {{kind}} files — and there is no stored document behind this row to hand to anything else.

viewer.dialogDescription: A preview of {{name}}, filed under this application. Press Escape to go back to the record.
viewer.noteSavedDescription: It shows against this file wherever the vault lists it.
viewer.noteEmptyDescription: The note is now empty, so nothing shows against this file.
viewer.truncated: Only the first megabyte is shown. Save opens the whole file in your own application.
viewer.failedTitle: This browser would not open the preview
viewer.failedDescription: {{error}}. The file's record in your vault is unaffected — only the preview could not be built.
viewer.fullScreenDescription: {{name}}, full screen, with a notes panel. Press Escape to go back.

notes.title: Notes
notes.hint: Kept against {{name}}, and shown wherever this file is listed.
notes.label: Notes on {{name}}
notes.placeholder: What matters in this document — the deadline buried on page 3, who to ask about it…

viewer.notPdf: The bytes in this file are not a PDF, so jojo will not show them as one.

toast.deletedDescription: {{description}} — gone from the calendar as well as this list.
